DSA concepts behind the app

DAG

Topics are vertices and prerequisite relationships are directed edges. The graph should contain no cycles.

Topological sort

Kahn’s algorithm places prerequisites before the topics that depend on them in O(V + E) time.

Dynamic programming

DP calculates the longest prerequisite-chain duration by reusing previously computed results for each topic.

Built as an educational Data Structures and Algorithms project.
